== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|The [[Advocates]] are a group with highly conflicting reputations across different regions. In the [[Free Worlds]], they are viewed as exemplary citizens and vital protectors who rose from a group of vigilantes to hold quasi-official [[Authority|authority]]. Within these territories, they are celebrated for risking their lives to serve the needs of various planets. Conversely, those in the Alliance perceive them as an ineffective organization that lacks true military capability and fails to share their specialized [[Aethertech]]. While some see them as heroic protectors of the galaxy similar to the [[Titan Force]], others view them as an unnatural blight against the [[Aether]]. Internally, the group is divided by disagreements regarding whether they should expand their influence across the galaxy or strictly adhere to their original mandate. They are also noted for their devotion to [[Starhammer]] and a tendency to prioritize their public image, though they maintain certain moral boundaries.}}

== The Engineer ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|[[Advocates]] serve as entities responsible for the preservation of evidence. These beings, which include individuals such as [[Clockworker]], are associated with colors like blue. During a confrontation, a witch Advocate was observed positioned back-to-back with a swordsman. Following these events, [[Mell D-One-Twenty-Five|Mell]] was designated to be surrendered into the custody of an Advocate.}}
